title: Chipotle-Honey Sweet Potato Wedges
summary: Cornstarch-dusted wedges roasted hot on two pans, then tossed in chipotle, honey, and lime.

steps.title: Coat
steps.text: Toss the wedges with the cornstarch first, then the oil and salt. The cornstarch dries the surface and helps it crisp.

steps.title: Spread out
steps.text: Spread across two sheet pans with space between the wedges. Crowded wedges steam each other and go soft.

steps.title: Roast
steps.text: Roast, flipping halfway, until browned at the edges and tender inside.

steps.title: Glaze
steps.text: Warm the honey, chipotle, and lime juice together and toss with the hot wedges right out of the oven. Glazing at the end keeps the honey from burning.

notes: Sweet potatoes hold more water and sugar than regular potatoes, which is why they go soggy. Cornstarch, space on the pan, and glaze-last fix it.
